verdict.rationale: Community reports show macOS ships first-party command-line utilities out of the box: pbcopy/pbpaste, networkQuality, qlmanage and hidutil. These can be scripted from a terminal. However, the evidence holds no first-party documentation of an official CLI and nothing tying these tools to agent or AI workflows. missing for 10: first-party docs for an official CLI/Terminal toolset, any AI/agent-oriented CLI capability, machine-readable docs (llms.txt and markdown docs return 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: pbcopy/pbpaste are among a user's most-loved tools
networkQuality is a handy built-in replacement for opening Speedtest when checking whether the network is slow.
qlmanage converts SVG to PNG without installing anything extra
hidutil remaps keys without extra software
